articles.headline: Moderna's mRNA flu shot gets FDA adcomm
articles.summary: Moderna's mRNA-based seasonal influenza vaccine will face FDA advisory committee review after previously receiving a refuse-to-file letter. The newsletter also covers multiple other biotech developments including Kelun-Merck's positive lung cancer data combining their TROP2 ADC with Keytruda, and Biogen/Denali discontinuing their Parkinson's program after Phase 2b failure.
articles.why_it_matters: The FDA advisory committee review represents a critical milestone for mRNA technology's expansion beyond COVID-19 vaccines and could validate Moderna's platform diversification strategy, while the Parkinson's failure highlights ongoing challenges in neurodegeneration drug development.
